text: Theoretically, any finite structure or process can be made to seem consistent for a short duration, and all pyramids or Ponzi schemes work until they don't. The problem is that in order for the scheme to work, it needs to grow, and the growth needs to be exponential. Most people, including the scammers, will underestimate how quickly exponential growth works. So, for example, if you're a Ponzi scammer, and your fund grows by 10% every month, that's quite manageable. Now, in 5 years, you're growing at 100%. So in 5 years, you've doubled your investments. In 10 years, you've quadrupled, in 15 years, you've octupled, in 20 years, you've 16x'ed, and so on. So, it's very easy to look at a Ponzi scheme, and say, "Oh, this is working fine, and we're making 10% a month, so we're all fine," until we're not.
